latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Switch to recently released docker images by @codefromthecrypt in https://github.com/openzipkin/zipkin/pull/3824
* Add flatten-maven-plugin for Sonatype Central Portal by @codefromthecrypt in https://github.com/openzipkin/zipkin/pull/3825
* Remove outdated BOM warning from dependencyManagement by @codefromthecrypt in https://github.com/openzipkin/zipkin/pull/3826
* Update Netty to 4.2.12.Final by @reta in https://github.com/openzipkin/zipkin/pull/3831
* Bump armeria to 1.38.0 by @AlexKolpa in https://github.com/openzipkin/zipkin/pull/3830

## New Contributors
* @AlexKolpa made their first contribution in https://github.com/openzipkin/zipkin/pull/3830

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openzipkin/zipkin/compare/3.6.0...3.6.1
